query: how to automate weekly reports by email
title: How to automate weekly reports by email | 50agents
description: Automate a weekly report email: fix the window to last Monday to Sunday in your timezone, compare with the week before, and make empty weeks say so.
h1: How to automate weekly reports by email
answer: Pick three to five numbers, fix the window to last Monday to Sunday in your timezone, and email them every Monday against the week before.
Make the report say when data is missing, never a silent zero.

then.why: It sends a PDF and a link to up to 50 recipients a schedule. Reports with errors are not sent, so watch for a missing Monday.

then.answer: Use Apps Script, or an automation
then.why: Apps Script needs a little code and a time trigger, with 6 minutes per run. An automation tool can read the sheet and send the email instead.

then.q: Should the report explain what changed?

then.answer: Use an automation on a schedule
then.why: Fixed steps read the numbers and send them. Check which timezone the schedule runs in.

options.label: Yes, in a line of words

then.answer: Use an AI agent on a schedule
then.why: It reads, compares and writes why the number moved. It costs more per run than fixed steps; worth it when the why matters.

steps.title: Write the report by hand once
steps.body: Open the source, pull last week's numbers, and write the email you would want. That email is your spec.

steps.title: Fix the window in words
steps.body: "Payments from last Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59, Europe/London". Print the window and timezone in the report itself.

note.text: A schedule set in UTC moves an hour when daylight saving starts. Set it in your own timezone.

steps.title: Schedule it after the data settles
steps.body: If payouts or ad spend arrive overnight, send at 9:00, not 0:05.

steps.title: Make empty and failed weeks visible
steps.body: If a source returns nothing, the email says "no payments found between X and Y", not "$0". If a step fails, you hear about it the same morning.

steps.title: Send to yourself for two weeks
steps.body: Check each one against the source by hand. Then add the team.

captain.line: Captain plans an AI agent that reads, compares and writes the summary each Monday. You see when it runs and what it asks you first before it is built.

wrong.title: The report says $0
wrong.body: The data was late or the search found nothing. Make the report say what it searched and that it found nothing.

wrong.title: The window is off by a day
wrong.body: "Last 7 days" counted from the send time. Use calendar weeks in your timezone.

wrong.title: It failed and nobody noticed
wrong.body: A connection expired and the report simply stopped. Pick a tool that tells you about failed runs, and notice the Monday it does not arrive.

wrong.title: The person who built it left
wrong.body: The schedule ran from their account. Build reports on a shared account, or write down who owns them.

faqs.q: Can Google Sheets email a report on a schedule?
faqs.a: Not by itself. Apps Script can, with a time trigger and a little code, or an automation tool can read the sheet and send the email.

faqs.q: Can Looker Studio email a report weekly?
faqs.a: Yes. Scheduled delivery sends a PDF and a link to up to 50 recipients; free schedules can run at most daily.

faqs.q: What timezone does a scheduled report use?
faqs.a: It depends on the tool: Looker Studio uses your computer's timezone, Zapier uses the account's. Always check, and print the window in the report.
